maya (People Ops): Quick all-hands follow-up thread on remote/hybrid + offsite ops. I'll answer short Qs and pin links.

jordan (Eng): What's the travel cap for a week in SF?

maya (People Ops): Domestic flights up to $500; hotels $325/night in SF. Receipts required.

sasha (Eng-Infra): How do we reserve recurring desks for a team week?

carlos (People Ops): Use the Team Space Request form (pinned). For single days, use hot-desk booking. Book recurring by the Wed before the week.

jordan (Eng): Childcare during overnight offsites?

rebecca (People Ops): Childcare reimbursement up to $150/day with manager sign-off for company-sponsored overnight events. Submit receipts.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Any special rules for shipping demo hardware to a venue?

carlos (People Ops): Equipment >$2k needs IT + legal sign-off and a transport form. Small items okay.

jordan (Eng): Visa letters timeline?

maya (People Ops): Start 6-8 weeks out, attach passport scan and dates in the travel form; we'll prepare the invitation.

offsite-bot: poll started "Offsite month preference" Apr / May / Sep. Results in 24h.

maya (People Ops): I'll post a one-page FAQ and update the offsite kit with these clarifications. DM us for exceptions. :wave:
